cues.en: As we saw in Hello World, we can use OpenAI or Azure OpenAI with Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 在 Hello World 範例中，我們看過如何搭配 Microsoft Agent Framework 使用 OpenAI 或 Azure OpenAI。

cues.en: But we are in no way limited to those.
cues.zh: 但我們完全不受限於這兩家。

cues.en: The reason why I chose those and spent more time than other models is that this is what I'm going to use throughout this course.
cues.zh: 我選擇它們，而且花比較多時間介紹，是因為後續整門課都會使用它們。

cues.en: And I'm especially going to use Azure OpenAI because that's my preferred provider.
cues.zh: 尤其會使用 Azure OpenAI，因為這是我偏好的供應商。

cues.en: Azure OpenAI is pay-as-you-go, so it's cheaper, but it requires a little more setup, while OpenAI, as I mentioned in the video, needs five US dollars up front before
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 採隨用隨付，比較划算，但設定步驟稍多。OpenAI 則如影片所提，必須先儲值 5 美元，

cues.en: you can begin to use it.
cues.zh: 才能開始使用。

cues.en: But again, there's so many more models, Google's models, Anthropic models, Mistral, and so on.
cues.zh: 不過，還有非常多其他模型，例如 Google、Anthropic、Mistral 等。

cues.en: And I'm going to go through how each of these are being connected using Microsoft Agent Framework, so you have a reference if you
cues.zh: 我會逐一介紹如何用 Microsoft Agent Framework 連接它們，方便你在想用

cues.en: want to use some of the others.
cues.zh: 其他供應商時參考。

cues.en: So let's get through this.
cues.zh: 現在開始逐一看看。

cues.en: So OpenAI, we saw, very simple, OpenAI Client, Chat Client, and so on.
cues.zh: OpenAI 剛才看過了，非常簡單：OpenAIClient、ChatClient 等等。

cues.en: And we only used this one specific NuGet package.
cues.zh: 而且只需要這一個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: Azure OpenAI, a little more complicated because we needed two NuGet packages, and we needed to put in an endpoint as well.
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 稍微複雜一些，需要兩個 NuGet 套件，還得填入端點。

cues.en: Google is probably the one that are the least supported at the moment, as of this recording being 6th of January, 2026.
cues.zh: 以這段影片錄製的時間，也就是 2026 年 1 月 6 日來說，Google 大概是支援程度最低的一家。

cues.en: There is a new official Google NuGet package underway, but so far we have only been to an unofficial package.
cues.zh: 新的 Google 官方 NuGet 套件正在開發中，目前還只能使用非官方套件。

cues.en: As soon as the official package goes live, I will believe that it's just as capable as the rest.
cues.zh: 等官方套件推出，我相信它就會和其他供應商一樣完整。

cues.en: But for now, we have this generative AI Chat Client package that we need to NuUp.
cues.zh: 目前我們需要建立這個 Generative AI ChatClient 套件的用戶端。

cues.en: And while it looks like it can do the same here, it has certain limitations when you come to more advanced stuff.
cues.zh: 雖然看起來能完成相同的操作，但在更進階的功能上仍有一些限制。

cues.en: In terms of getting your API keys, you do that in aistudio.google.com or you can also use the Google Cloud Platform.
cues.zh: API 金鑰可以到 aistudio.google.com 取得，也可以使用 Google Cloud Platform。

cues.en: Then we have Anthropic.
cues.zh: 接著是 Anthropic。

cues.en: Anthropic have an official Microsoft Agent Framework package, just like OpenAI have.
cues.zh: Anthropic 和 OpenAI 一樣，也有官方的 Microsoft Agent Framework 套件。

cues.en: And in that, we just need to new up an Anthropic Client, and in that we need to give the API key.
cues.zh: 只要建立 AnthropicClient，並傳入 API 金鑰即可。

cues.en: And when we then use the agent, we need to give some extra information, because we can't give the model in the client itself.
cues.zh: 接著使用代理程式時，還需要額外提供一些資訊，因為模型不能直接在用戶端裡指定。

cues.en: We need to give it in something called Chat Options here.
cues.zh: 必須在這裡的 ChatOptions 中設定。

cues.en: And a very important thing for Anthropic is you also always need to give how many tokens per call you can use.
cues.zh: Anthropic 還有一個重要要求：每次呼叫都必須指定可使用的 Token 數量。

cues.en: So we do almost the same, but we just need to give some additional Chat Client agent options here with some model ID and
cues.zh: 所以操作幾乎相同，只是要額外傳入 ChatClientAgentOptions，包含模型 ID 和

cues.en: options.
cues.zh: 其他選項。

cues.en: But beyond that, it's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 除此之外就完全一樣。

cues.en: Mistral from France have also only an unofficial package, but you can use it together with
cues.zh: 法國的 Mistral 目前也只有非官方套件，但可以搭配

cues.en: the agent's AI.
cues.zh: Agents.AI 使用。

cues.en: And you just new up a Mistral client, give your API key, and write mistral-client.completions
cues.zh: 建立 MistralClient，提供 API 金鑰，再呼叫 mistralClient.Completions

cues.en: .create-ai-agent, because this completions is an iChat client.
cues.zh: 上的 CreateAIAgent，因為這個 Completions 實作了 IChatClient。

cues.en: You go to admin.mistral.ai in order to get your models and API keys.
cues.zh: 模型與 API 金鑰可以到 admin.mistral.ai 取得。

cues.en: XAI or Grok is possible to use as well.
cues.zh: 也可以使用 xAI，也就是 Grok。

cues.en: And Grok is one of those models that have just adhered to the OpenAI spec instead of making their own API.
cues.zh: Grok 採用 OpenAI 的 API 規格，而沒有另外設計自己的 API。

cues.en: So what you do is you just use the OpenAI package, and instead of just giving the API key, you also need to give some options where you point to an endpoint,
cues.zh: 因此直接使用 OpenAI 套件。除了 API 金鑰，還需要透過選項指定端點，

cues.en: meaning you point to XAI's endpoint instead of OpenAI's endpoint.
cues.zh: 也就是連到 xAI 的端點，而不是 OpenAI 的端點。

cues.en: But beyond that, it works exactly the same way as OpenAI.
cues.zh: 除此之外，使用方式和 OpenAI 完全相同。

cues.en: And you will see this throughout some of these models that they have just taken the same approach as OpenAI.
cues.zh: 接下來還會看到不少模型都採取這種與 OpenAI 相同的介面。

cues.en: Microsoft Foundry is a bigger thing.
cues.zh: Microsoft Foundry 的範圍比較大。

cues.en: You still use two NuGet packages, but instead of the OpenAI package, you use the Azure AI package.
cues.zh: 一樣使用兩個 NuGet 套件，但把 OpenAI 套件換成 Azure AI 套件。

cues.en: So this is something called persistent agents, meaning that in the other cases, we have in memory made our agent.
cues.zh: 這裡使用所謂的持久化代理程式；前面幾種情況，代理程式都是建立在記憶體中。

cues.en: In Microsoft Foundry, you actually make an agent, and it becomes a permanent thing up in that portal.
cues.zh: 在 Microsoft Foundry 中，建立的代理程式會持續保存在入口網站裡。

cues.en: You use something called AI project client in order to do this, and you can't get an API key for it.
cues.zh: 操作時使用 AIProjectClient，而且不能用 API 金鑰。

cues.en: You need to use a role-based access system from Azure to work with them.
cues.zh: 必須使用 Azure 的角色型存取控制機制。

cues.en: Once you do that, you get your client, and it can create agents, and there are even version histories, so you can go back
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，就能建立代理程式，甚至還有版本歷程，可以在不同

cues.en: and forward between agents, and you can set up your models on what agents should be used.
cues.zh: 版本間切換，並設定代理程式使用的模型。

cues.en: Once you have done all that, you can just get your AI agent like normal, and you don't need to create it every single time.
cues.zh: 完成這些設定後，就可以像平常一樣取得 AIAgent，不必每次重新建立。

cues.en: If you have the name and it already exists, you can just get the agent in that manner.
cues.zh: 只要知道名稱，而且它已經存在，就可以直接取得。

cues.en: There will be separate lectures on Microsoft Foundry because it's a much bigger thing, but for now, we can just see that it is
cues.zh: Microsoft Foundry 的範圍大得多，所以會另外用講座介紹。目前只要知道，

cues.en: possible to work with them, but they work slightly different than the rest.
cues.zh: 它也可以搭配使用，只是操作方式和其他供應商略有差異。

cues.en: Then we have Amazon Bedrock, which is part of the Amazon AWS system.
cues.zh: 接著是 Amazon AWS 系統中的 Amazon Bedrock。

cues.en: They have their own official NuGet package for ME-AI, meaning Microsoft Extensions AI, and we
cues.zh: 它有專門給 MEAI，也就是 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 使用的官方 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: use them together with Agents AI, and once you do that, you can make a new client.
cues.zh: 搭配 Agents.AI 後，就能建立新的用戶端。

cues.en: In order to do that, you need to make an environment variable, so it needs to be in environment values.
cues.zh: 認證資訊需要設定為環境變數，也就是放在環境變數裡。

cues.en: You can't really set it on the client itself, but no big deal.
cues.zh: 不能直接在用戶端上設定，但這不算什麼問題。

cues.en: Then you need to know what region you are in and get this runtime client.
cues.zh: 接著指定所使用的區域，取得 RuntimeClient。

cues.en: Once you have one of those, you can turn it into these iChat clients, and once you have that, you get the normal Microsoft agent.
cues.zh: 取得後，把它轉成 IChatClient，就可以建立一般的 Microsoft 代理程式。

cues.en: Then we have Ollama, which is an offline model, so you go and download the Olama service.
cues.zh: 再來是 Ollama，這是離線執行模型的選項。先下載 Ollama 服務，

cues.en: You instal it in your machine, and you run some commands to download the offline models.
cues.zh: 安裝在電腦上，再執行指令下載離線模型。

cues.en: Once you have done that, you make an Olama client using something called OllamaSharp.
cues.zh: 完成後，使用 OllamaSharp 建立 Ollama 用戶端。

cues.en: This is technically unofficial, but as it's offline, it doesn't really matter too much.
cues.zh: 嚴格來說這是非官方套件，但因為在本機離線使用，影響比較小。

cues.en: This client is by default also an iChat client, and instead of some endpoint up in the cloud, you hook it up to a
cues.zh: 這個用戶端本身也實作 IChatClient，不過連線位置不是雲端端點，而是

cues.en: local host or wherever you host the Olama service.
cues.zh: localhost，或你部署 Ollama 服務的地方。

cues.en: You tell what model you want, and then you just take this client and turn it into an iChat client agent, and from there on, it's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 指定模型，再把用戶端轉成 ChatClientAgent，後面就完全一樣了。

cues.en: Another offline thing you can do is Microsoft version called Foundry Local.
cues.zh: 另一個離線方案是微軟的 Foundry Local。

cues.en: In Foundry Local, you have Winget, or you can download it from a website, and you can instal the Microsoft Foundry Local as a
cues.zh: 可以透過 winget 或網站下載 Foundry Local，並把 Microsoft Foundry Local 安裝成

cues.en: Windows service.
cues.zh: Windows 服務。

cues.en: Once you have that, you have a NuGet package dedicated for that from Microsoft, and behind the scenes, it's using the OpenAI spec, so
cues.zh: 安裝完成後，使用微軟提供的專用 NuGet 套件。它底層採用 OpenAI 規格，所以

cues.en: we just use the Microsoft Agent Framework OpenAI NuGet package.
cues.zh: 直接使用 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 OpenAI NuGet 套件。

cues.en: In order to do this, we then use something called a Foundry Local Manager that says it wants to start the model.
cues.zh: 這裡透過 FoundryLocalManager，要求啟動模型。

cues.en: So we have our model name, we start that model, and we get a manager back that it has now started the model, where we will get the information about the model,
cues.zh: 指定模型名稱並啟動之後，會取得管理器，裡面提供目前已啟動模型的相關資訊，

cues.en: like, for example, its real ID.
cues.zh: 例如模型真正的 ID。

cues.en: This is just the alias of the model, like the open source chat GPT.
cues.zh: 這裡填的只是模型別名，例如開放原始碼的 GPT 模型。

cues.en: Once you have that, you need to make an OpenAI client, and all OpenAI clients need an API key, but you can just paste anything in here.
cues.zh: 接著建立 OpenAIClient。OpenAIClient 一定要有 API 金鑰，但這裡可以填任意字串。

cues.en: In this case, no API key, and the endpoint will be given on the fly by the manager, so it will be some local
cues.zh: 例如這裡填 no-api-key。端點則由管理器即時提供，會是一個本機

cues.en: host and a port that it assigns on the fly.
cues.zh: 位址，以及動態指派的連接埠。

cues.en: And once we have that, it is exactly the same as we normally do.
cues.zh: 之後的做法就和平常完全一樣。

cues.en: We get our chat client with our model, and we get our agent, so we can do our run async.
cues.zh: 取得指定模型的 ChatClient，再建立代理程式，就可以呼叫 RunAsync。

cues.en: Then we have OpenRouter.
cues.zh: 接著是 OpenRouter。

cues.en: OpenRouter is one of these companies that have made deals with all the different providers, so you can use Anthropic, you can use OpenAI,
cues.zh: OpenRouter 和各家供應商合作，讓你能使用 Anthropic、OpenAI，

cues.en: you can use Grok, you can use all the different models from almost any provider out there.
cues.zh: 也能使用 Grok，幾乎各家供應商的各種模型都能透過它取得。

cues.en: And they have, as well, taken the OpenAI as a NuGet package, so you just new
cues.zh: 它同樣採用 OpenAI 的 NuGet 套件，所以只要

cues.en: up with OpenAI, and you put in your endpoint being OpenRouter.ai.api.v1. And once
cues.zh: 建立 OpenAIClient，把端點設成 openrouter.ai/api/v1。設定好之後，

cues.en: you have that, it works exactly the same.
cues.zh: 使用方式就完全相同。

cues.en: Same goes for another of these multi-LLM providers, together.ai. It's exactly the same, but
cues.zh: 另一家整合多種 LLM 的供應商 Together.ai 也是同樣的做法，

cues.en: just with a different URL.
cues.zh: 只是網址不同。

cues.en: We also have Cohere, works exactly the same way as well.
cues.zh: Cohere 也能用同樣的方式操作。

cues.en: They have their own models only, and they are fairly limited, but they are good for small education scenarios.
cues.zh: 它只提供自家的模型，限制比較多，但很適合小型教學情境。

cues.en: We have HuggingFace, which is one of these free offerings, so you can technically work on all this for free.
cues.zh: Hugging Face 則有免費方案，理論上可以免費練習這些內容。

cues.en: They don't have some of the big models.
cues.zh: 它不提供某些大型模型，

cues.en: It's more the more open source, the more small models that exist out there, and they are by far the biggest provider of models.
cues.zh: 主要是開放原始碼與較小的模型，而且模型數量非常多。

cues.en: You can use them using OpenAI, so it's exactly the same setup, just with a different endpoint.
cues.zh: 一樣可以使用 OpenAI 用戶端，設定完全相同，只要換端點。

cues.en: The final one we have is GitHub Models, which is probably the best way of getting hold of OpenAI and all the bigger models
cues.zh: 最後是 GitHub Models，這可能是免費取得 OpenAI 和其他大型模型

cues.en: for free, because as part of GitHub, you can get with some fairly heavy rate limits,
cues.zh: 最好的方式。GitHub 提供這項服務，但速率限制相當嚴格。

cues.en: but I guess you could manage throughout this course to stay on GitHub Models if you wish to.
cues.zh: 不過，如果你願意，我想整門課應該都可以使用 GitHub Models 完成。

cues.en: You go up and make a personal access token up in GitHub, and then you use Azure AI Inference as a connector, so you
cues.zh: 先在 GitHub 建立個人存取權杖，再使用 Azure AI Inference 連接，

cues.en: make one of these chat completion clients that needs a URL, which is the inference URL
cues.zh: 建立 ChatCompletionsClient，需要提供推論端點網址，

cues.en: for GitHub, the Azure key credentials, which is your GitHub personal access token, and then you
cues.zh: 也就是 GitHub 的推論網址，以及 AzureKeyCredential；這裡的金鑰就是 GitHub 個人存取權杖。接著，

cues.en: can say, as AI client, in order to get your AI client here, and then it's
cues.zh: 呼叫 AsIChatClient，取得這裡的 AI 用戶端，然後就能

cues.zh: 像平常一樣執行，只是需要的 NuGet 套件比較多，也比較不同。

cues.en: That's the negative part about this, plus the quite heavy rate limits.
cues.zh: 缺點就是套件較多，加上嚴格的速率限制。

cues.en: Of course, if you pay, you can use it without rate limits, but if you want it free, it is one of the options
cues.zh: 當然，付費後可以使用更高的額度；如果要免費，這確實是一種

cues.en: to actually get OpenAI for free.
cues.zh: 免費使用 OpenAI 模型的選項。

cues.en: And that's all the different providers I have tried over the times.
cues.zh: 以上就是我這段時間試過的各家供應商。

cues.en: There are probably many more, and they are probably mostly just some OpenAI spec version, so
cues.zh: 應該還有更多，而且大多可能都採用某種 OpenAI 相容規格。

cues.en: as you can see, you can easily hook up to almost anything in this agent framework,
cues.zh: 可以看到，透過 Agent Framework，幾乎任何服務都很容易接上，

cues.en: so it's no way a vendor login to Microsoft or to OpenAI in any way.
cues.zh: 所以完全不會被綁在微軟或 OpenAI 上。

cues.en: So that was the bonus.
cues.zh: 以上就是這段補充內容。
